vision.name: Red Barrier
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(Red Relentless Mastery only. You may only have one "Red Barrier" attached. If this card is banished from your Life Deck, attach it to your MP.)
[Defense] Stops an energy attack.
While attached, your Styled attacks deal +1 life card. Lower your opponent's anger 1. [Trait:Android]: Raise your anger 1.
